title: Bijou64: A variable-length integer encoding
summary: Bijou64 is a novel variable-length integer encoding scheme that efficiently encodes integers of arbitrary size using a variable number of bytes, similar in concept to UTF-8's byte-length strategy. The encoding optimizes for small numbers by using fewer bytes while maintaining support for arbitrarily large integers.
problem_solved: Provides an efficient compact representation for encoding integers of varying magnitudes with fewer bytes for small values while supporting arbitrarily large numbers.
why_valuable: Offers an elegant alternative to existing varint encodings (like LEB128 or Protocol Buffers) with potentially better properties for certain use cases, demonstrated by strong community interest (227 HN points).
